title: GODsend PSP video guides
intro: Short screen recordings of every tab of the GODsend PSP desktop app, from plugging in the console to managing plugins. The demo data shown is fixture data, no real console is involved.

sections.title: Getting started
sections.summary: See your PSP and what is on it.

videos.title: The Console
videos.description: Plug the PSP in over USB and the Console tab shows the memory stick: free space, games and homebrew, disc images, save folders and library size, plus rescan, open, eject and environment checks.
steps: Connect the PSP in USB mode
Use Rescan, Open Stick, Eject Safely or Run Checks
Watch the queue on the right

videos.title: Library
videos.description: Everything installed on the stick next to what you keep on your computer. Copy a game back to your computer, or open its info.
steps: Press To Local to copy a game to your computer

videos.title: Store
videos.description: Search PSP games through the Game Debrid index or Internet Archive. Links are resolved through Real-Debrid or TorBox, then downloaded with aria2c.
steps: Pick Game Debrid or Internet Archive

videos.title: Downloads
videos.description: Finished downloads wait here. Change the download folder or send a file to the memory stick with To PSP.
steps: Change the folder if you like

videos.title: Files
videos.description: A two-pane file manager: your computer on one side and the memory stick on the other, with folders, up and delete.

sections.title: Homebrew and media
sections.summary: Put software, music, video and disc images on the stick.

videos.title: Homebrew
videos.description: Browse emulators and custom firmware and install in one click, or import your own zip.

videos.title: Music
videos.description: Convert tracks to MP3 or M4A, or copy as-is, and push them to the stick.

videos.title: Video
videos.description: Convert movies to the PSP AVC profile, generate .THM thumbnails and push them to the stick.
steps: Choose Convert to PSP AVC or Copy as-is

videos.title: Disc images
videos.description: Import ISO or CSO images and convert between them, optionally compressing to CSO on import.
steps: Use To CSO or To ISO

videos.title: Save data
videos.description: Back up every save folder or only the ones you pick, and restore from a backup zip.
steps: Press Backup All or select some
Restore Zip to bring them back

videos.title: Mods
videos.description: Manage plugins, themes and custom firmware. seplugins are grouped by environment (Game, VSH, Pops); add a .prx, switch it on or off, or remove it.

videos.title: Settings
videos.description: Add Real-Debrid or TorBox keys for the Store, choose store sources, set the downloads folder and the default music and video conversion.
